Baseline coverage matrix for current HolSmt parser, HOL-to-SMT-LIB translator, solver entry points, and Z3 proof replay. This is not a completeness claim.

## Status Legend

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| implemented | Implemented in current source for the stated surface. |
| parse only | Parsed or normalized intentionally, with no replay step for this surface. |
| unsupported diagnostic | Rejected or unavailable through an explicit diagnostic rather than silently accepted. |
| untested | Implementation may exist, but no current checked coverage is identified here. |
| unknown | Coverage has not been established. |
| not applicable | The column does not apply to this row. |
